common_future_controls.future_architecture_microbatch_policy: Own reviewed stage; return for explicit review on a feasibility issue; E1 does not implement or authorize other architectures

approval_snapshot_at_preparation.implementation_method: To be explicitly selected with G1; not a numeric training value
approval_snapshot_at_preparation.approval_binding: Future explicit G1 record must bind this exact file byte SHA-256 and authorize implementation; neither this preparation snapshot nor the checksum grants permission

data.label_id_definition: Index in the immutable labels.json ordered list, 0 through 123

image_access.invalid_samples: fail and record; never skip or replace
image_access.path_policy: Resolve manifest-relative paths inside configured dataset root; reject escapes and label mismatches

audit.policy: Passing train/val hash audit and preprocessing conformance bound to actual root/content and accepted packages before GPU work; keep dataset immutable and repeat when root/content/packages change; archived pilot evidence alone is not new official target acceptance

preprocessing.geometry_ui_and_resize_authority: Use frozen config/module directly; no duplicate coordinate table, weights.transforms(), preview inputs, EXIF transposition, uint8 requantization, or alternative backend

augmentation.application: Frozen valid-scene photometric formulas before UI mean fill; brightness before contrast; preserve masks/padding

model.stochastic_depth_schedule: TorchVision 0.23.0 block-index linear schedule from 0 to 0.1

pretrained.verification: Require exact filename, existence, and full digest before strict state loading
pretrained.starting_state: Fresh pinned ImageNet weights for every tuning trial and final seed; fresh optimizer and scheduler; no pilot/trial warm-start

selection.reference: Global maximum M over all four valid completed trial selected-checkpoint scores
selection.final_lr: Derived only from this locked reviewed selection; not independently tuned

failure_policy.operational_interruption: Record and resume the same declared trial from its committed boundary under identical identity and original budget
failure_policy.invalid_or_uncompletable_candidate: Stop and return for explicit user review; do not ignore, replace, or select from a subset
failure_policy.records: Retain all failures, interruptions, replays, and any reviewed retries with identity/lineage; no silent fresh replacement

stage_authorization.tuning: G3a after G1/G2; official UIT Slurm only
stage_authorization.post_selection: STOP and hand off complete ledger and selected-LR evidence
stage_authorization.final: Separate G3b after user reviews T11a handoff; declarations do not launch jobs

batch.train_sampling: Natural shuffled permutation without replacement; every unique train image exactly once per completed epoch
batch.validation_sampling: All validation images in fixed manifest order, no shuffle or augmentation
batch.accumulation_loss: For each accumulation group with D actual original images, sum unweighted CE and divide by D, including all short tails; one optimizer/scheduler update per completed group

loss.name: standard_unweighted_cross_entropy
loss.loss_reporting: Sample means over all split images, never unweighted averages of batch means

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.group_validation: Enumerate actual parameter names; every trainable tensor appears exactly once; fail unexpected categories, duplicates or omissions; all groups share candidate base LR and schedule
optimizer.numerical_failure: Nonfinite logits/loss/unscaled gradients or OOM fails and is recorded; no silent batch/update skip or LR/batch/resolution/runtime substitution

budget.success: Exactly eight completed training epochs and eight complete validations; never a shortened successful run

scheduler.name: linear_warmup_then_update_cosine
scheduler.update_index: u is the zero-based optimizer update being executed, 0 <= u < N; L is the candidate base LR, W=1000, N=139992, f=1e-6
scheduler.application: Apply LR(u) before optimizer update u; advance completed-update state only after the update; validation does not advance scheduler

endpoints.final_floor_equality: Exact at final update; no remaining scheduler update is executed afterward

scheduler.restoration: Restore the same completed-update position and immutable full horizon/parameters; do not reset warmup or change horizon based on selected checkpoint; reject over-budget updates

initialization.seed: official training seed for this run
initialization.rng_context: Isolated CPU RNG context immediately around initialization; restore outer CPU RNG afterward

derived_seed.encoding: UTF-8 of pipe-separated str values: str(training_seed) followed by each key part, joined with |

epoch_order.generator: Fresh CPU torch.Generator seeded with derived_seed; torch.randperm(dataset_length)
epoch_order.persistent_workers: Carry epoch with every sampled index; never depend on a mutable parent-only epoch

augmentation.generator: Fresh CPU torch.Generator seeded with derived_seed
augmentation.draws: Two sequential torch.rand scalar draws, brightness then contrast, each mapped by 1-amplitude+2*amplitude*draw

loaders.generator: Separate CPU torch.Generator per split; state saved/restored
loaders.worker_python_numpy_seed: torch.initial_seed() % 2**32; seed Python and NumPy in worker initialization; torch worker seed comes from DataLoader generator

rng.process_start: Set PYTHONHASHSEED=str(official_training_seed) before Python startup; verify actual value per run; never copy 3406
checkpoint_state: train and validation loader generator states
rng.partial_epoch: Replay from the last committed completed epoch boundary using restored original run state; record replayed operational work separately

environment.PYTHONHASHSEED: str(official_training_seed), exported before Python process startup

runtime.tf32_environment_overrides: Reject any effective environment override that enables TF32; record actual effective Torch settings, not requested values alone
runtime.execution_identity: Record actual software/runtime/source/data identity and actual driver/device/allocation for accepted target and each run. Material differences from the reviewed environment cannot silently proceed; T10/G2 acceptance must pass under actual conditions before official execution. Preserve accepted run identity on resume; operational job IDs and MIG UUIDs are recorded, not fixed equality requirements.
runtime.pilot_driver_reference: 580.126.20; historical supporting evidence, not an unconditional exact-driver lock
runtime.local_validation: Documentation/contract checks only during T00; future CPU fixtures are never official UIT evidence

deployment.gpu_work: Only inside reviewed UIT Slurm allocation after stage-specific authorization
deployment.target_acceptance: T10: separately authorized real-weight/full-size synthetic or train-only forward/backward and boundary-resume acceptance; not P1-v2, an optimization experiment, or a tuning trial
deployment.walltime_resume: A job walltime never changes the original eight-epoch horizon. Preserve last completed boundary; replays do not add completed budget or authorize a new candidate.

checkpoint.rule: Select first completed epoch initially; replace only when current_metric - selected_metric > tau, where tau = 1e-6; retain earlier checkpoint otherwise; NLL cannot break ties

roles.last.pt: Atomic full-state committed boundary for same-run resume; never resume from best.pt

checkpoint.boundaries: Initial boundary zero plus completed-epoch boundaries; include completed update counters, original budget, model/optimizer/scheduler, inactive scaler policy, RNG/loaders, full history and selected-checkpoint state
checkpoint.identity: Distinct official checkpoint kind with resolved configuration/contract hash, fixed artifact/preprocessing/pretrained fingerprints, official accepted source/environment and seed/run/stage identity; reject pilot checkpoint kinds and mismatches
checkpoint.safety: Atomic replacement and one writer per immutable run directory; failed writes retain prior committed boundary; no overwrite with a new trial
checkpoint.reports: All per-run metrics must come from the same selected checkpoint even when last.pt is later; final runs never initialize from selected tuning model state

reporting.ranking: Descending original logits; exactly tied logits ordered by ascending label_id; never alter logits
reporting.macro_f1: Average full-split per-class F1 over GT-supported classes only
reporting.unsupported_f1: null; excluded from supported macro average
reporting.weighted_f1: Weight full-split per-class F1 by evaluation GT support
reporting.bucket_f1: Average supported bucket member per-class F1 computed on entire evaluation split, retaining cross-bucket false positives
reporting.bucket_topk: GT-conditioned bucket samples ranked across all 124 outputs; no-support bucket metrics are null
reporting.machine_precision: Preserve full floating-point values in JSON/CSV; do not round before aggregate calculations

human_display.std: Same percentage units and four decimals as mean

reporting.pilot_metrics: Diagnostic only; no official score acceptance threshold or evidence substitution
reporting.final_test_access: Locked; later explicit user authorization only after E1/E1-HR/E2 protocols/checkpoints are appropriately frozen; E1 training and reporting expose no test evaluator

provenance.numeric_authority: Explicit user instruction reproduced in docs/E1/t00_review.md; input approval does not approve G1

preparation_checkout.note: Workspace has newer reviewed task-ledger semantics; preparation checkout is not the future official implementation identity
